description:
[1] Go to the website and type in your prompt like a cheerful girl sitting on a park

[2] Ideogram generates 4 images. Pick the one you find the best and click on remix

[3] Now keep the main character, "cheerful young girl" intact and change the setting to sitting in a coffee shop

And ideogram will generate the image with your consistent character. 

Follow artificial quotient for more such cool AI!
